title: parse_sse_block empty data_lines arm dispatches to parse_state_data unnecessarily
description: sse.rs parse_sse_block: the match data_lines.as_slice() [] arm calls parse_state_data('') which attempts JSON parse of empty string, fails, and returns Unknown. The intent is just Unknown. Suggested rewrite: '[] | [_blank] if _blank.is_empty() => SseEvent::Unknown, [single] => parse_state_data(single)' or more simply just handle [] as Unknown directly without a round-trip through parse_state_data.
